extraction.Name: Lucy Cottier Janis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, and accepted it under protest on the advice of the Farmer and Superintendent, who told her that if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes that she would lose the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her land for $350.00 in connection with the allotment of her husband, and was unable to pay the mortgage and lost the land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: unable to pay the mortgage and lost the land; told that if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes that she would lose the land
extraction.NOTES: In poor health, suffering with a tumor in her head which gives her a continual headache; mentally competent; has five children depending on her and her husband for support; has no land and no home; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent to her land; sworn before notary November 28, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
